terra.problem: The lifeguard joke makes inability to see the punchline, contrary to the rule against jokes about disability.
The empty tower is an invented detail. The passage does not mention a tower.
The joke changes dogs that cannot bark into a dog that won't bark.
The explanation narrows discernment to knowing which path is safe and calls that the whole skill of a shepherd. The verse says neither.
The explanation reduces the shepherds' lack of discernment to not knowing the way. The verse does not specify that.
The passage says each shepherd seeks his own gain, but it does not say the sheep are not even on his mind.
The comparison has someone planning to change tomorrow, while the shepherds picture tomorrow as more of the same. The actions do not match.
Calling the shepherds cheerful states a feeling the passage does not give.
Papa comments on his own delivery when he says he is not joking here.
The verse says they poured out a drink offering and offered a grain offering. It does not say they poured out both.
The claim that coming back to God comes up later in the passage adds a connection the text does not state.
The passage does not say the people associated with praise in verse 19 are a different people.
The explanation asserts that failing to remember God means they once knew Him. The verse does not make that additional statement.
The quotation uses “Me” and “My,” but the explanation does not first identify God as the speaker.
The verse does not say the oppressed and humble are people the world overlooks.
The cookie jar joke makes light of the serious sin and striking described in the verse.
